subject: Org sponsor + procurement path — post-discovery recap (Solstice Health)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@solsticehealth.com>, Miguel Torres <m.torres@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: org sponsors & procurement path

Hi Aditi / Miguel — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our end and three asks so we can move to pricing and a mutual action plan: 

Recap
- Discovery covered: ingesting EHR-derived clinical notes into your recommendation pipeline, expected peak QPS ~20 r/s, latency SLOs 300–500ms, strict PHI-in-scope constraints.
- Key non-functional asks: SOC 2 evidence, region-specific hosting (us-east), ability to run in a customer VPC if needed.
- Success metric: reduce triage review time by 30% while keeping FPR <5%.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you share the names and roles for the stakeholders we should be engaging? Specifically: economic buyer (budget approver), procurement contact, security/compliance reviewer, and the clinical champion. If you prefer, a simple org chart or a chain of intros works.
2) Any target procurement timeline or PO cadence we should be aware of?
3) I attached a short pricing one-pager and a blank mutual action plan — I can populate the MAP once we have the approver/PO details.

I cc'd Karthik (solutions) to schedule a scoped demo focused on integration patterns if helpful. If you can send the stakeholder names/contacts this week we can have a draft MAP back to you within 48 hours.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0186

Attachments: pricing-onepager-solstice.pdf (one-pager), Solstice_MVP_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (MAP template)

From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@solsticehealth.com>

Date: 2026-02-13T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: org sponsors & procurement path

Thanks Jordan — great summary and appreciated the docs. Per your asks:

Stakeholders (high level)
- Economic buyer: Miguel Torres (VP, Product) — m.torres@solsticehealth.com (he's on the thread)
- Procurement: Priya Nambiar (procurement lead) — priya.nambiar@solsticehealth.com
- Security/compliance reviewer: Daniel Wu (Dir, InfoSec) — daniel.wu@solsticehealth.com
- Clinical champion: Dr. Leena Patel (Clinical AI lead) — leena.patel@solsticehealth.com

Procurement timeline
- Target Q2 decision window; procurement prefers PO + standard MSA with redlines only for data residency or liability caps.

Next asks from our side
- Can you confirm SOC 2 status and share a one-page summary (we may ask for the cert later).
- High-level estimate for a 6-month pilot (us-east hosting, up to 20 qps).

I'll loop Priya and Daniel on a follow-up once we have an MAP draft. Happy to provide an org chart if that helps — attaching a quick contact list from my side.

Thanks,
Aditi Shah
Product Ops | Solstice Health
aditi.shah@solsticehealth.com

Jordan — thanks for the ping and for the clear asks. Quick notes and deliverables from legal/ops: 

Deliverables (this week) - SOC 2 summary: I attached a 1-pager we can share publicly (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- Standard MSA & common redlines: attaching the MSA snippet and a short guidance note (see attachments).
- MAP: Jordan, please send your draft MAP; I'll add procurement milestones and suggested SLA language for pilot.

Procurement / legal guidance - Solstice's preference for PO + standard MSA is straightforward — we typically accept PO for pilots <$50k. Anything above that usually triggers a review of liability caps and data residency clauses.
- If they need customer-hosted (VPC) option, we will need a completed security questionnaire and a network diagram before we start provisioning — I can start the intake once we have Daniel/Wu on a quick call.

I'll propose two slots for a short intake call with Daniel/Wu and Priya next week to align on evidence and timeline. Jordan — please add Priya.nambiar@solsticehealth.com and daniel.wu@solsticehealth.com to the MAP once you have the draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts & Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
